atom.description: UI patterns that nudge, manipulate, or coerce users into agreeing to data processing they would not freely choose — pre-checked boxes, asymmetric button prominence, multi-step opt-out journeys, dark-side defaults. Illegal under GDPR Art. 4(11) (consent must be 'freely given') and explicitly enumerated in the EU Digital Services Act and EDPB Guidelines 03/2022.
